svg.desc: Two panels sharing a vertical axis, the uncertainty that an observer has left about a quantity, as a share of where it starts, from 0 to 1, against periods from 0 to 20, when she takes in 0.25, 0.5 or 1 bit per period. Each line has a dot at every period. Left, a fixed fact: each line falls toward zero, shrinking by a factor of 0.71, 0.5 and 0.25 a period. Right, a quantity that takes a fresh shock each period: each line falls and levels off at a floor, 0.60, 0.25 and 0.083 of the start, marked by thin dotted lines with their values to the right.
